claims.claim: LG DirectDrive 7kg washing machine for sale.
claims.evidence: Witness report shows a white LG front-load washer with “LG” on the control panel and “DirectDrive 7Kg” text visible (photo 0).
Witness report explicitly reads “DirectDrive 7Kg” on the left side of the control panel (photo 0).

risks.risk: Unknown working condition (no proof it powers on, heats, and completes a full wash/spin cycle).
risks.proof: A short video clip showing the machine powering on, selecting a wash program, running through at least the wash and spin stages, and ending normally (with no error codes).
risks.if_unproven: Price as not fully tested/unknown working condition (worst case: may need repair).

risks.risk: Rust/oxidation and dirt stains near the lower front edge/door area may indicate corrosion, leaks, or poor maintenance.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of the rusted areas plus a clip showing the base area after a short run (no water pooling) and checking for active leaks.
risks.if_unproven: Price at a lower tier due to visible corrosion/wear (worst case: water ingress or component damage).

risks.risk: Possible drum/inner condition issues (photos don’t show the drum interior).
risks.proof: A clear photo through the open door showing the drum interior, rubber seal condition, and any mold/scale buildup.
risks.if_unproven: Price as potentially dirty/needs cleaning or service (worst case: heavy buildup affecting performance).

risks.risk: Drain pump/filter and drainage performance not shown; could clog or fail to drain properly.
risks.proof: A clip showing the machine completing a cycle and draining fully (no standing water at the end).
risks.if_unproven: Price as unknown drainage condition (worst case: clogged filter/pump requiring service).

risks.risk: Missing accessories/hoses or incorrect installation parts (not shown).
risks.proof: Photos showing included inlet hose, drain hose, and any accessories/attachments that come with the unit.
risks.if_unproven: Price as may require buying missing hoses/accessories (worst case: additional cost to make it usable).

risks.risk: Electrical/voltage compatibility and power rating not shown; could be mismatched or unsafe.
risks.proof: A photo of the rating plate/label showing voltage and model details, plus a power-on test.
risks.if_unproven: Price as unknown electrical specs (worst case: needs verification/possible replacement parts).

risks.risk: Noise/vibration/balancing during spin not shown; could indicate suspension or bearing wear.
risks.proof: A short video during the spin stage showing vibration level and whether it balances without excessive shaking.
risks.if_unproven: Price as unknown spin health (worst case: bearing/suspension issues).

proof_requests: Video: power on → select a program → run through wash and spin → finish with no error codes.
Close-up photos of the rust/corrosion areas and the rubber door seal; then a clip showing no water pooling after a short run.
Photo through the door showing the drum interior and seal condition.
Clip showing the machine draining fully at the end of a cycle (no standing water).
Photos of included inlet hose, drain hose, and any accessories that come with it.
Photo of the rating plate/serial/model label (clear enough to read voltage and exact model).
Video during spin to assess noise and vibration/balancing.
response.reason: The witness clearly identifies the item as an LG DirectDrive 7kg front-load washer, so it can be priced at its worst-case based on visible external wear/rust and the lack of proof it runs. Final value should be adjusted once working/drain/spin and inner condition are verified.
